Dear Dr. Chen and team,

We need the following before we can complete our review. This letter is a request for information, not a denial.

1. Patient identifier. The member or patient ID is required on every request and was not included.
2. Patient date of birth. The date of birth is required on every request and was not included.
3. Conservative treatment documentation. The applicable fictional policy requires documentation of at least 6 weeks of conservative treatment (physical therapy and/or NSAIDs/analgesics) unless red-flag symptoms are present. None was included, and the current note documents no red flags. Please send the treatment type, start and end dates, and the patient's response.

Please reply through the provider portal and reference PA-20260925-0006.

Prior Authorization Team, [Regional Health Plan — Demo]
